tools.name: cloudsign_list_documents
tools.description: List the team's documents with their status: 0 draft, 1 waiting for recipients, 2 concluded, 3 cancelled or declined, 4 template. Paged, 100 per page. GET /documents.

tools.name: cloudsign_get_document
tools.description: Get one document with its status, files and participants. GET /documents/{documentID}.

tools.name: cloudsign_list_cabinets
tools.description: List the cabinets (folders) of the team. GET /cabinets.

tools.name: cloudsign_create_document
tools.description: Create a new draft document. Then add files and participants, and send it with cloudsign_send_document. POST /documents.

tools.name: cloudsign_update_document
tools.description: Change the title, note, message or transfer setting of a document. PUT /documents/{documentID}.

tools.name: cloudsign_add_participant
tools.description: Add a recipient to a document. Wait 2-10 seconds before the next call on the same document. POST /documents/{documentID}/participants.

tools.name: cloudsign_add_file
tools.description: Upload a file (usually PDF) to a document. Send the file bytes base64-encoded in content_base64, up to about 10 MB. Wait 2-10 seconds before the next call on the same document. POST /documents/{documentID}/files.

tools.name: cloudsign_send_document
tools.description: Send a draft document to its recipients, or send a reminder for a document that was already sent. Recipients get an email at once, and this cannot be undone. POST /documents/{documentID}.

tools.name: cloudsign_delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft document. Only drafts can be deleted; sent documents cannot. DELETE /documents/{documentID}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cloudsign_send_document · Private data: cloudsign_list_documents, cloudsign_get_document, cloudsign_create_document, cloudsign_update_document, cloudsign_add_participant, cloudsign_add_file, cloudsign_send_document, cloudsign_delete_draft · Public sink: cloudsign_create_document, cloudsign_add_participant, cloudsign_add_file, cloudsign_send_document · Destructive: cloudsign_delete_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cloudsign_send_document · Private data: cloudsign_list_documents, cloudsign_get_document, cloudsign_create_document, cloudsign_update_document, cloudsign_add_participant, cloudsign_add_file, cloudsign_send_document, cloudsign_delete_draft · Public sink: cloudsign_create_document, cloudsign_add_participant, cloudsign_add_file, cloudsign_send_document · Destructive: cloudsign_delete_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
